[Pedagogy review · Suggestion · extension · pf-d2c0753e96]
Append to p33-q3: (c) The region bounded by y=2x² and y=2x³ is rotated about the x-axis. Find its volume. Answer: 8π/35 u³. (d) Rotate this new region about the y-axis. Find its volume. Answer: π/5 u³. (e) Compare each new volume with its corresponding answer in part b. Answer: four times as large about the x-axis and twice as large about the y-axis. (f) Explain why these multipliers differ. Answer: x-axis radii double, so their squared values quadruple; about the y-axis, corresponding radii stay the same while the vertical extent doubles.
